notes.Victor Wembanyama: He played 32 minutes with 32 points Wednesday at Chicago after playing 24 to 26 minutes in three games before that, including 40 points in 25 minutes Monday. notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He is probable with a right wrist sprain and has scored 43.5 or more DraftKings points in each of his last four games, with at least 11 rebounds in all four. Cleveland is without Evan Mobley, which takes a big body away from the Cavaliers' frontcourt.
notes.Bam Adebayo: He has played 33 to 41 minutes in each of his last four games but has scored 18 or fewer points in his last three. Evan Mobley is out for Cleveland, so the Cavaliers' frontcourt is thinner than usual.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: He has scored 26 to 31 points in each of his last four games, with 31 in 36 minutes Wednesday at Portland. Oklahoma City is still without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams, and Ajay Mitchell is questionable with a left ankle sprain.
notes.Isaiah Hartenstein: He had 20 points, 11 rebounds and six assists in 34 minutes Wednesday at Portland, his most minutes in his last four games. Chet Holmgren and Jaylin Williams are out again, so the center minutes go to him and Aday Mara.
notes.Franz Wagner: With Paolo Banchero out again, he has played 38 to 40 minutes in each of his last four games and topped 50 DraftKings points in all four, including 38 points Wednesday at Utah. Jalen Suggs and Tristan da Silva are both questionable.
notes.Anthony Black: He has played 33 to 39 minutes in his last three games with Paolo Banchero out, scoring 26 and 22 points in the last two. Jalen Suggs is questionable, which would add even more ball-handling for him if Suggs sits.
notes.Alperen Sengun: He has played 35 to 39 minutes in three of his last four games and posted 52 or more DraftKings points in those three, with 19 points, 13 rebounds and nine assists Wednesday. Clint Capela and Steven Adams are out, so Houston has no other true center behind him.
notes.Kevin Durant: He has played 34 to 38 minutes in each of his last four games, with 23 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists on Monday. Utah is without Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, but Houston is a 17.5-point favorite, which raises the risk of a short night.
notes.Reed Sheppard: Marcus Smart is serving a league suspension, which opens backcourt minutes. Sheppard played 20 minutes off the bench with 13 points Wednesday.
notes.Jalen Johnson: He has played 36 and 38 minutes in his two games since returning from his ankle sprain, scoring 30 points on Saturday. Kingston Flemings is questionable with lumbar spasms, and Atlanta's game at Chicago has the slate's highest total at 245.5.
notes.Josh Giddey: He played only 25 minutes with 19 DraftKings points Wednesday after 51.75 in 34 minutes on Nov. 8. Caleb Wilson is out and Norman Powell is questionable with low back spasms, which would leave more of the offense to Giddey.
notes.Jalen Smith: He has started and played 30 minutes in each of his last two games, scoring 23 points with five threes Wednesday. Caleb Wilson is out again, which keeps the frontcourt minutes open for him.
notes.Domantas Sabonis: He returned Tuesday from knee soreness but was held scoreless in 24 minutes while Dylan Cardwell played 29. Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons are out, and Precious Achiuwa is questionable with left ankle soreness.
notes.Dylan Cardwell: He played 29 minutes with 11 rebounds Tuesday, more than Domantas Sabonis in Sabonis's return. Maxime Raynaud is out and Precious Achiuwa is questionable, so Cardwell stays in the big-man rotation.

notes.Damian Lillard: He played both games against Oklahoma City this week, with 18 points in 32 minutes Wednesday. Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe are out again, but Portland's blowouts have often cut his fourth-quarter minutes.
notes.Sidy Cissoko: He has started Portland's last two games over Scoot Henderson, playing 33 and 29 minutes and scoring 17 and 19 points. Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe are out again, but he had only two rebounds and no assists Wednesday.
notes.Jrue Holiday: He played 30 minutes off the bench Wednesday with 19 points and five assists. Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe are out again, which keeps his backcourt minutes up.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He has posted 50 or more DraftKings points in each of his last three games, with 21 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists in 34 minutes Wednesday. New York has no one on tonight's injury report, and Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton.
notes.Jalen Brunson: He scored 27 points in 35 minutes Wednesday and has scored 23 or more in each of his last four games. New York has no one on tonight's injury report, and Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton.
notes.Pascal Siakam: He has scored 28 and 29 points in his last two games, with 58.75 DraftKings points on Monday. Tyrese Haliburton is out again and Aaron Nesmith is questionable with right knee soreness.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: He has started every game with Tyrese Haliburton out and has played 34 minutes with 12 and 10 assists in Indiana's last two games. Haliburton is out again tonight.
notes.Quenton Jackson: He has come off the bench in Indiana's last four games, playing 17 to 25 minutes. Aaron Nesmith is questionable with right knee soreness, which could add minutes for him.
notes.Donovan Mitchell: He scored 23 points with six assists in 36 minutes Wednesday and had 37 points on Nov. 7. Evan Mobley, Sam Merrill and Nae'Qwan Tomlin are all out tonight.

notes.Thomas Bryant: Evan Mobley is out, and Bryant is the backup center behind Jarrett Allen. He has played 13 to 16 minutes in his recent games, so his minutes should rise with Mobley out.

notes.Tyrese Proctor: He has played 19 to 23 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games, with 15 points Wednesday. Evan Mobley and Sam Merrill are out again.

notes.Jerami Grant: He has played 20 to 24 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games, scoring 14 points Wednesday. Zach Edey, Scotty Pippen Jr. and Quinten Post are all out tonight.

notes.Brandin Podziemski: With Stephen Curry out, he played 37 minutes with 22 points Wednesday and has scored 40 or more DraftKings points in his last two games. Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Brandon Williams are out too.
notes.Charles Bassey: He is probable with left toe soreness. Kristaps Porzingis is not with the team, so Bassey stays in the backup center role, where he has played 11 to 18 minutes in his last four games.
notes.Dylan Harper: He had 18 points, six rebounds and 10 assists in 36 minutes Wednesday. De'Aaron Fox (left hip soreness) and Devin Vassell are both questionable, which would add ball-handling for Harper if either sits.
notes.De'Aaron Fox: He is questionable with left hip soreness. He had 17 points and nine assists in 31 minutes Wednesday, his most minutes in his last four games.

notes.Bennett Stirtz: He has played 18 to 29 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games. Cason Wallace and Jalen Williams are out, and Ajay Mitchell is questionable with a left ankle sprain.
